# Roundtable-Agent

> Roundtable-Agent seats the AI assistant apps on your Android phone (Pickle, Muse, Vooy, Cue) at one table and lets Claude Code chair the meeting. You ask once in a web room; Claude decides which assistants to ask, sends the questions through a phone worker app that types into each app for you, reads every answer, and writes one summary. Self-hosted, single user, Docker Compose.

Key ideas:

- Assistant apps without a public API are driven through an Android accessibility-service worker (phone) or uiautomator2 (emulator). Each app is an MCP server with the same two tools: `ask` and `status`.
- Claude Code runs headless as the orchestrator (fan-out, relay, debate, summary) and only talks to assistants through those MCP tools.
- Other assistants can post into a room over HTTP (`POST /api/inbox`) and fetch Claude's answer later.
- Works with phones and tablets, including apps shown in pop-up or split-screen windows.
